evals.prompt: I want to connect Claude to our Shopify store so it can manage products. We haven't set up any API access yet.
evals.expected_output: A walkthrough that installs the CLI, authenticates, creates a custom app with the correct Admin API scopes, stores the token securely, and verifies the connection.
expectations: Guides creating a custom app with an Admin API access token, not just a CLI session token
Lists specific Admin API scopes needed (e.g. read_products, write_products, read_content, write_content)
Instructs storing the access token in .dev.vars (or equivalent) and ensuring it's gitignored, not committed
Verifies the connection with a test GraphQL query against the Admin API
Uses an explicit dated API version rather than 'unstable'
